items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: What’s the boy the police put in jail? James Brown, the King of Rhythm-and-Blues.

ctx.x: Yeah, names. What’s the boy the police put in jail? James Brown, the King of Rhythm-and-Blues.

items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The Godfather of Soul. I was on, almost on the right track.

ctx.x: You got it. One of them was the King of Rhythm-and-Blues. The Godfather of Soul. I was on, almost on the right track.
When you were up in New York around that time, people like Charlie Christian hadn’t gotten there yet, huh?
